import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,hashlib,base64,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd(); raw=json.loads((p/'raw20.json').read_text())
def write(n,o):
 s=o if isinstance(o,str) else json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
 z=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py',n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
notes={
347767:('PARK_NO_FULL_MECHANISM','For every finite disjoint family of oriented cycles, need an outdegree threshold forcing a subdivision of the entire disjoint union. A single-cycle theorem does not bound the number of vertices used, so deleting that subdivision may destroy all available outdegree. No bounded-deletion or disjoint-reservoir lemma proved. Primary definition of delta+-maderian not read here.'),
347790:('PARK_FLAGSHIP','Need invariance for every realization of a fixed lattice and every 0<n<ell-1. Vanishing in small dimensions is insufficient. No bridge from lattice to the logarithmic derivation sheaf or all its cohomology; actual source theorem bodies not read. Terao equivalence in raw record is not independently established.'),
347885:('HOLD_DEFINITION','M_(n,t), H(n), and strength0 refer to missing construction. No fabricated graph or crossing convention. An upper drawing count supplies no lower bound over all drawings. Recover source construction and parameter domain before attempting a topological certificate.'),
347980:('HOLD_UNQUANTIFIED','Inverse relationship has no specified inequality, parameters held fixed, or functional comparison. Need initial polynomial domain, r and Q0 definitions, deterministic algorithm and literal ordering of runtimes. Divergence near zero would not imply global antitonicity. No endpoint correction credited.'),
348059:('PARK_INFINITE_ACTION','All primes and countably infinite valencies enter; finite primitive graph examples do not address distance sequence1,aleph0,p. Need exact distance-cardinality convention and a primitivity/block argument for infinite automorphism groups. No all-prime obstruction constructed.'),
348075:('PARK_NO_FULL_MECHANISM','Need every triangle-free planar graph to admit a fractional cover by induced forests of total weight<=8/5. A single large induced forest or unweighted induced-forest conjecture fragment does not supply all weighted LP dual constraints. No all-weight induced-forest inequality or counterexample with dual certificate proved; no LP run.'),
348101:('PARK_LOCAL_GLOBAL_GAP','Induced exclusion of digon, directed triangle, outstar2 suggests locally transitive outneighborhoods. It does not imply global acyclicity: a directed cycle of length>=4 still fits. Need a 2-coloring with no monochromatic directed cycles in every allowed graph plus a lower witness for equality2. Native search gave no usable primary body; no no-hit inference.'),
348179:('HOLD_UNPAID_TRANSFER','Two sustained routes in DERIVATIONS.md. Prior threshold gives g>=k and k=0, not g<k. Exact generating-series gap transfer has signed Q, so nonnegative denominator coefficients do not prove completeness. Literal invalid g=0,k>0 needs fidelity clarification, not credit.'),
348216:('PARK_FLAGSHIP','Universal soficity quantifies over all finitely generated groups and finite Hamming approximations/metric ultraproducts. Raw first sentence misphrases the individual-group definition. Finite/residually finite examples give only subclasses. No full approximation or nonssofic witness mechanism, and no ultrafilter or metric-quotient formal bridge.'),
348293:('PARK_REALIZABILITY_GAP','Need every noncrossing matching ensemble satisfying all source axioms realized by one generic simple polypositroid. Linkage/noncrossing alone have not been translated to a consistent strict support-inequality system. No realization theorem or infeasible exact oriented-matroid witness; tautological raw polypositroid definition insufficient.'),
348400:('PUBLIC_FULL_SCOPE_THEOREM','Original Conjecture12 connected-graph convention and definitions match Chen-Ma2607.27573v2 final application. Four exhaustive cases and scope bridge in DERIVATIONS.md. Full new paper text read; external cited theorem bodies not independently audited. Zero credit, no new adaptation claimed.'),
348457:('HOLD_UNPAID_GLOBAL_SIGNS','Two sustained component/insertion routes in DERIVATIONS.md. One-component monotonicity does not give general GN. Full-tree coefficient identity preserves mandatory inner reticulations but leaves global coefficient signs, especially descending side, unproved. No numerical enumeration.'),
348495:('PARK_TOPOLOGY_GAP','Need all 4^6-subcube partitions to fail the exact quadrisection manifold/handlebody intersection conditions. Failure of symmetric gcd(4,6) construction excludes only that construction, not arbitrary partitions. No local link obstruction covering every partition, and no full literal quadrisection definition read.'),
348553:('PARK_CLASSIFICATION_GAP','An infinite finite-type upho indecomposable modular lattice with complemented rank3 interval must be coordinatized over a local PID of finite residue field. No reconstruction of ring or coordinatization and no nonmodule lattice witness. Finite interval agreement would not establish infinite-poset isomorphism.'),
348650:('HOLD_HYPERGRAPH_SCOPE','Raw says complete balanced k-partite graph while T is k-uniform. Need actual source to confirm hypergraph host, k,n positivity, tight-tree convention and decomposition. k=2 would already include a general bipartite tree-packing problem. Misparsed graph versus hypergraph is no substantive counterexample; no decomposition mechanism.'),
348661:('PARK_INVARIANT_GAP','Need all nonisomorphic trees separated by self-H-chromatic symmetric functions with both graph and target varying. Ordinary chromatic symmetric function or homomorphism count to one fixed target does not pay this quantifier. No coefficient recovery of tree isomorphism or exact collision constructed; definition not invented from notation.'),
348728:('HOLD_NATURALITY_SPEC','Need source algebraic-complex construction, higher Pascal indexing, differential and q-deformation/naturality requirements. Arbitrary vector spaces of each prescribed dimension would be a vacuous weakening. No literal categorification endpoint or compatible differential mechanism supplied.'),
348851:('HOLD_CLASS_DEFINITIONS','Raw statement requires BOTH strict inclusions among prefix-pure complex classes, not just inclusions or shifted subclass. Raw references contain a solved status about a different shelling assertion; this does not prove this conjecture. Need definitions and strict witnesses with full implication bridges. No source theorem read here.'),
348915:('PUBLIC_FULL_SCOPE_COUNTERPART','Guarded public K2 square K3 square K5 witness applies to full circulant statement. Ordinary CRT, intrinsic common-neighbor edge types, full automorphism pair orbits and tensor spectral bridge are explicit in DERIVATIONS.md. Same public witness and mechanism, zero credit; no public formal certificate locally audited.'),
348981:('HOLD_REDUCTION_DEFINITION','Need source reduction meaning and direction (usually all independent sets of reduction remain independent in M), capacity convention and k. Coloring into k independent classes alone does not permit exchanging one element per color arbitrarily. No partition with capacity/independence and2k-cover bridge, no explicit counterexample.'),
}
source={348179:['sources/2010.01655.pdf'],348457:['sources/2010.13324.pdf'],348915:['sources/2012.01905.pdf','sources/circulant-public-counterpart.html'],348400:['sources/2010.10487.pdf','sources/2607.27573.pdf']}
results={}
for x in raw:
 ident=x['id'];o=x['object'];out,note=notes[ident]; b=base64.b64decode(x['raw_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256'];assert json.loads(b)==o
 results[str(ident)]={'mathdb_id':ident,'title':o['title'],'statement':o['statement'],'source_url':o['source_url'],'provenance':{k:x[k] for k in ['chunk','chunk_sha256','line_1based','raw_sha256','statement_sha256']},'raw_preserved_in':'raw20.json raw_base64 includes original newline','outcome':out,'credit':0,'accepted':False,'gates':{'literal':'READ_FULL_RAW_AND_STATEMENT; domain qualifications in note','source':'SELECTED_PRIMARY_BODY_PASS_WITH_LIMITS' if ident in source else 'NOT_ACQUIRED; literal-only park','math':'PUBLIC_WITNESS_BRIDGE_COMPLETE_NOT_NEW' if ident==348915 else 'PUBLIC_THEOREM_SCOPE_BRIDGE_COMPLETE_NOT_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT' if ident==348400 else 'UNPAID_FULL_SCOPE','prior':'EXACT_APPLICABLE_PUBLIC_COUNTERPART_READ' if ident in [348915,348400] else 'BOUNDED_HISTORY_AND_ROOT_METADATA_ONLY; NOT_CLEARED','novelty':'FAIL_THIS_LANE_ALREADY_PUBLIC' if ident in [348915,348400] else 'UNESTABLISHED; no open-label/no-hit inference','significance':'NO_NEW_SIGNIFICANT_RESULT_SHOWN','formal':'NOT_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED; no literal kernel endpoint','independent':'NOT_DONE; worker is not independent reviewer','acceptance':'FAIL_PENDING_REQUIRED_PIPELINE; worker cannot accept'},'ordinary_analysis_and_exact_unpaid_bridge':note,'primary_artifacts':source.get(ident,[]),'derivation_file':'DERIVATIONS.md' if ident in source else None,'formal_plan':'Dormant feasibility discussion in DERIVATIONS.md; no dispatchable survivor' if ident in source else 'No qualified candidate; source definitions and ordinary mechanism unpaid','search_scope':'search/plan1.json and plan2.json, only charged IDs therein; four registry roots charged all20; no other native calls','novelty_clearance':False}
assert set(results)==set(map(str,json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])) and len(results)==20
write('keyedresults.json',results)
heads={}
for q in (p/'sources').glob('registry-*.html'):
 heads[q.name]={'head':list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'"currentOid":"([0-9a-f]{40})"',q.read_text()))),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'depth':'root HTML metadata only; no directory-body or theorem inspection; no no-hit clearance'}
write('registry-metadata.json',heads)
# Correct exact-key history inventory without opening any additional historical bodies.
hist=json.loads((p/'history-read-inventory.json').read_text());write('history-assessment.json',{'read_files':len(hist),'initial_substring_hit':'r81 contained348851 somewhere in the complete serialized result, possibly hash/embedded metadata; not treated as exact result or novelty evidence','scientific_use':'none; only immutable allowlisted completed-result summaries; no paths followed','filter_before_open':['formal','code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-','r401','r402','r395/'],'limitation':'No exhaustive prior-art clearance. History output truncation makes unrelated full-body reading incomplete; no unrelated theorem relied upon.'})
print('WROTE exact20 gates and registry/history assessments')
